note: Owner, 2026-10-25: "run every hour so you can get the max out of the 70% quota." (Before: every 4 hours, owner 2026-09-30: "move to a cadence of updating the data every 4 hours or so ... never end up using more than 70% of my API quota.") every_hours is the period every refresh run arms timer.yml with after its own start (the watchdog's EVERY_HOURS / STALE_SUCCESS_MIN are pinned to it by scripts/test_cadence.py). The Warcraft Logs limit is per hour and the 70% cap is enforced against the account's live spend by scripts/wcl_client.py, so hourly runs use every hourly window at the same cap — four times the throughput of the 4-hour cadence, which a backlog of ~20k pending runs (2026-10-22 on) had shown to be too slow. quota_fraction is the share of the hourly limit EVERY collector process may spend. A time-boxed `burst` block {every_minutes, until} overrides the period alone while `until` is ahead (used 2026-10-07 at 30 min and 2026-10-14 at 15 min).
